idea-plugin.name: Flutter Developer Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Enhanced Pubspec.yaml Intelligence for Flutter & Dart Development

Flutter Developer Tools supercharges your Flutter and Dart development workflow with advanced pubspec.yaml intelligence. Get instant access to package information, documentation, and smart upgrade suggestions—all without leaving your IDE.

Key Features

🔍 Smart Package Discovery

  • Auto-complete pub.dev packages with real-time search
  • See Flutter Favorites (⭐) and likes count directly in completion popup
  • Automatically inserts the latest version when selecting a package

📚 Comprehensive Documentation

  • Hover over package names to view full README documentation
  • Hover over version numbers to see CHANGELOG with version history
  • Supports GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Codeberg, and SourceHut repositories
  • Intelligent handling of monorepo packages

🔗 Quick Navigation

  • CMD+click (CTRL+click on Windows/Linux) package names to open pub.dev package page
  • CMD+click version numbers to open specific version details
  • Direct links to repository and homepage URLs

🔄 Smart Update Management

  • Inline hints showing available updates with type classification (Major/Minor/Patch)
  • Warning annotations for packages with available updates
  • One-click safe upgrades that skip breaking major version changes
  • One-click full upgrades to the latest version
  • Optional automatic flutter pub get execution after upgrade

⚠️ Package Health Indicators

  • Visual badges for discontinued packages
  • Warnings for Dart 3 incompatible packages

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1+ with Flutter and Dart plugins installed.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.0 - Initial Release

Features

  • Smart Package Auto-completion: Auto-complete pub.dev packages with Flutter Favorites badge and likes count
  • Intelligent Package Insights: Hover over package names to view comprehensive README documentation with repository links
  • Version Changelog Access: Hover over version numbers to see CHANGELOG with version history
  • Direct Package Navigation: CMD+click (or CTRL+click) on package names and versions to open pub.dev pages
  • Update Notifications: Inlay hints showing available updates with categorization (Major/Minor/Patch)
  • Safe Upgrade Quick Fixes: One-click safe upgrades (skip major versions) and full upgrades with optional pub get execution
  • Package Health Indicators: Visual warnings for discontinued and Dart 3 incompatible packages
  • Multi-Repository Support: Fetches documentation from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Codeberg, and SourceHut
  • Monorepo Intelligence: Automatically handles packages in monorepo structures
